result.brief: 提出置信度引导的主动学习框架，为动作条件世界模型（EnerVerse-AC）在潜空间预测稠密置信图，实现任务/帧/块级数据预算分配与局部训练增强。
result.reason: Confidence-guided active learning for action-conditioned embodied world models (EnerVerse-AC), improving post-training of video world models; main contribution is training/data selection, not representation, but directly targets world models.
